{
  "candidate_rtl": "module mux_large (
    input [7:0] block_a, block_b, block_c, block_d, block_e,
    input [7:0] block_f, block_g, block_h, block_i, block_j,
    input [3:0] sel,
    output reg [7:0] block_out
);
    wire hi00, hi01, hi10;
    wire lo00, lo01, lo10, lo11;
    wire en_a, en_b, en_c, en_d, en_e;
    wire en_f, en_g, en_h, en_i, en_j;

    assign hi00 = ~sel[3] & ~sel[2];
    assign hi01 = ~sel[3] &  sel[2];
    assign hi10 =  sel[3] & ~sel[2];

    assign lo00 = ~sel[1] & ~sel[0];
    assign lo01 = ~sel[1] &  sel[0];
    assign lo10 =  sel[1] & ~sel[0];
    assign lo11 =  sel[1] &  sel[0];

    assign en_a = (hi00 & lo00) | (sel[3] & (sel[2] | sel[1]));
    assign en_b = hi00 & lo01;
    assign en_c = hi00 & lo10;
    assign en_d = hi00 & lo11;
    assign en_e = hi01 & lo00;
    assign en_f = hi01 & lo01;
    assign en_g = hi01 & lo10;
    assign en_h = hi01 & lo11;
    assign en_i = hi10 & lo00;
    assign en_j = hi10 & lo01;

    always @* begin
        block_out = ({8{en_a}} & block_a)
                  | ({8{en_b}} & block_b)
                  | ({8{en_c}} & block_c)
                  | ({8{en_d}} & block_d)
                  | ({8{en_e}} & block_e)
                  | ({8{en_f}} & block_f)
                  | ({8{en_g}} & block_g)
                  | ({8{en_h}} & block_h)
                  | ({8{en_i}} & block_i)
                  | ({8{en_j}} & block_j);
    end
endmodule",
  "bottleneck": "The likely critical path is select decoding through the default-selection logic and the eight-bit data-selection network. Shared select signals also drive substantial fanout.",
  "rewrite": "Use explicit parallel one-hot data gating with shared two-bit predecodes. Select block_a directly for sel=0 or sel[3] && (sel[2] || sel[1]), avoiding a default enable formed by negating the union of the other nine selections. Present the output as a flat OR of masked inputs so mapping can use compound gates and balance the reduction.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The simplified default enable may shorten the select-to-output path while retaining parallel data selection. No mapped timing results are available, so improvement over the baseline is not established.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Shared predecodes limit duplicated logic, but enable buffering and the mapped OR network determine final area. Compliance with the 1006.089920 um^2 cap and zero electrical violations requires the specified mapping and timing checks; neither is claimed as measured.",
  "functional_boundaries": "For every two-state input, sel=0 through 9 selects block_a through block_j respectively, and sel=10 through 15 selects block_a. Exactly one enable is asserted for each two-state select value. All port widths, unsigned data behavior, and combinational latency are preserved. There are no parameters, clocks, storage elements, external dependencies, or input assumptions. Four-state X/Z propagation is not asserted equivalent."
}
